svg.title: A question of an agent
svg.desc: An agent of the maintainer, such as an orchestrator on their PC, sends the event pager-ask with gh to the private control repository, with an id, a question and two to four options. Its workflow takes only an event of the maintainer, checks it and sends it to the Worker, signed. The pager opens a topic for the question, with one button per option. The maintainer presses one, or writes their own answer in the topic, and the GitHub App saves it as answers/id.json on the branch pager-answers of the control repository. The agent reads it there with gh, without a secret of its own, and wait takes only an answer newer than the question. An agent that no longer needs the answer sends pager-withdraw: the buttons go, and the topic says that it took the question back.
